title: GridSoccer - Feedback wanted
author: FlashyMtl
selftext:
Started as a soccer board game ,3D printed for game nights, now it’s my first PC/phone game. Looking for honest feedback

A while back I designed a little soccer tactics board game and printed the whole thing on my 3D printer. Board, players, ball, the box, and 8 move cards (Juggle, Feint, Advance, Slide, Shot, Option, Pass, Safe) with the moves drawn on a mini grid. Played it a ton with friends and it was honestly way more fun than I expected. (pic of the printed version below)

At some point I wanted to see if it could work on a phone. I’m not a programmer, so I built it with AI. I did the design, the rules, the testing and every decision, and the AI wrote the code. Being upfront about that.

The game is called Grid Soccer. 3v3 on a 7x9 grid. The 8 cards sit around the pitch: one spot for you, one for the AI, and two on the sides. After every round all the cards shift one spot clockwise, so the card you can’t use this turn ends up in your hand next turn. Cards get shuffled once at kickoff and after that there’s zero luck. Both players see everything, kind of like chess.

It kept growing from there. There’s vs AI, pass and play on one phone, a chess clock, weather, a roguelike with 20 levels and 44 bosses, a deckbuilder, tiles, 7 languages.

Some stuff that gave me trouble:

The AI tests thousands of moves before playing, and each test was secretly triggering a sound. Phones would just crash mid-match. Took a while to figure that one out.  
I wanted the AI to play by the exact same rules as the player. No cheating, even on the hardest difficulty. Making it smarter without breaking that was harder than I thought.  
Balancing 44 bosses meant simulating hundreds of matches for each one.  
Chinese and Japanese text in a pixel font. Some characters just didn’t exist, so I had to rewrite sentences around them.  
Even the trailer. The card rotation looked choppy on video so I had to re-record it in slow motion.

Trailer is here: https://youtube.com/@gamingplayingonthego?si=x7MzJuUIlCaxlRKo  
There a Phone or PC preview

It’s still early, everything can change. I’m open to any criticism, good or bad, that’s why I’m posting.

I could also use some advice on releasing it. I’m thinking itch.io, Steam and the iOS App Store. If you’ve shipped on any of those as a solo dev, what would you do first? What do you wish you knew before? Anything I should watch out for?

Thanks for reading!

comments.author: florianDenu
comments.body: Really cool! I love the concept of combining soccer with chess-like strategy. The fact that you started with a 3D-printed board game and turned it into a full digital game using AI is pretty awesome. Looks like a lot of thought and effort went into it. Great work, love to play it already
